question: Does replacing the fixed +++ tensor by fixed +-+ change a controlled packet/clock encounter, after separately checking valid carrier and clock preparations?
discovery: The completed +++ interaction grid found conditional C events but no registered (I,r) memory. This comparison tests the user's sign-pattern suggestion. It is separate from the later same-board phase-memory validation.

seed_methods.same_seed: Use exactly the complete +++ initial triples, including every packet and clock halo, under either fixed tensor. Invalid singleton transport or clock behavior must be reported and prevents a cancellation claim.
seed_methods.tensor_aware: Use the existing GuidedPacketSource formula with the run's signed weights. For the side clock, choose initial b=q equal to the reciprocal guide-facing weight, so q*w_guide=+1; prepare every halo remainder using its actual signed weight and the full four-cycle phase. This is a new initial preparation, not a claimed global gauge transformation.

family.carrier_checks: Both seed methods, both tensors, and both directions on a pristine complete guide: eight independent full-state eight-update translation checks.

controls: First bit controls only packet initial counters; second controls only target clock initial counters. Every control group retains identical complete remainders. No reference clock is added here.
singleton_gates: An interaction cancellation claim is eligible only when the corresponding pristine forward carrier passes exact full-state translation and the clock-only whole board has period four. A quiet outlet caused by a broken incoming carrier is not interaction cancellation.

readouts.reuse: Use the original interaction protocol's full 336-channel region, individual external incoming terms, all-world C log, eight-update isolated (I,r) retention definition, and entire-horizon excess-event activation diagnostic without changing them.
readouts.signed_carrier_template: For outgoing matching, use all actual signed packet halo values. T(a,b,r)=(-b,-a,r) supplies the backward template on the same guide. Require the same four consecutive local translations as the original protocol.
readouts.strict_forward_cancellation: After singleton gates pass, at least one forward-outlet channel has nonzero counters in 10 during the fixed window, all 48 forward-outlet channels have zero counters throughout that window in 00 and 01, and all 48 remain zero throughout in 11. Complete output histories and all C are retained. This is local silence, not state deletion.
readouts.carrier_suppression: Record a valid forward carrier in 10 and no matching forward carrier in 11 separately from full outlet silence. A distorted packet is not automatically a canceled signal.
readouts.phase_or_release: No new phase-memory, physical comparator, capture, approval or release claim is made by this comparison.

no_wrap: All active preparations are at least forty lattice steps from boundaries; record every full state and reject any active boundary contact during the observation horizon.
retention: Retain all pristine carrier records and every completed four-control group with complete states, initial triples, actual inputs, all events and inverse checks. If the budget is reached, stop at a group boundary and report the unrun parameters.
presenter_selection: All four controls for tensor-aware seeds, r=0, phase=1, under each of the two tensors: eight selected experiments fixed before this comparison.
gauge_scope: The algebra audit found a local six-edge sign obstruction between +++ and +-+. No checkerboard or other diagonal sign gauge equivalence is assumed. Even when a restricted preparation behaves equivalently, this does not prove global tensor equivalence.
